m: प्रति-√ या P. -याति, to come or go to (acc., also with प्रति), RV.; MBh.; to go against (acc.), Hariv.; to go or come back, return to or into (acc.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to comply with, oblige, please (acc.), R.; to equal, be a match for (acc.), BhP.; to be returned or requited, ib. : Caus. -यापयति, to cause to return to (acc.), BhP.
a: प्रतिया — {c2c} P. To go back, return; R. 1. 72; 15. 18; 8. 91.

m: प्रति-˚याग a sacrifice offered with an aim towards anything, ĀpŚr., Sch.
प्रति—यामिनि ind. every night, Kathās.
प्रति-˚यात mfn. gone towards or against or back or away, turned, returned, opposed, MBh.; R.
प्रति-˚यात—बुद्धि mfn. one whose mind is turned towards (dat.), R.

s: strI, (pratiyAtyate anayA iti । prati + yat + Ric + “RyAsaSranTo yuc .” 3 । 3 । 107 । iti yuc .) pratimA । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 36 ॥ (yaTA, mAGe । 3 । 34 । “anirvvidA yA vidaDe viDAtrA pfTvI pfTivyA pratiyAtaneva ॥”) tulyayAtanA ca ॥

m: प्रति-˚यातना f. an image, model, counterpart, a picture, statue (of a god &c.), Ragh.; Śiś.; Hcar.
(ifc.) appearing in the shape of Hcar.
a: प्रतियातना — A picture, an image, statue; Śi. 3. 34.

a: प्रतियातनं — Requital, retaliation; as in वैरप्रतियातन.

m: प्रति-˚यात—निद्र mfn. ‘one whose sleep is gone’, awakened, wake, BhP.

v: tri॰ prati + yA--Bavizyati gamyA॰ Rini । BAviyAnayute BA॰ u॰ 5771 Slo॰ ।

m: प्रति—यूथप m. the leader of a hostile herd (of elephants), MBh.
प्रति—यूपम् ind. post by post, ĀpŚr.
प्रति-√ यभ् (only inf. -यब्धुम्), to have intercourse with a female, TBr., Sch.
प्रति-√ यज् P. -यजति, to sacrifice in return or with an aim towards anything (acc.), ŚBr.; ĀpŚr.
प्रति-√ यम् P. -यच्छति, to be equivalent to, be worth as much as (acc.), TBr.; to grant or bestow perpetually (Impv. -यंसि), RV.; to return, restore, BhP.
प्रति-√ यत् Ā. -यतते, to guard against, counteract, ŚBr.; Śak. i, 32/33 (v.l.) : Caus. यातयति, to retaliate, requite (with वैरम्, or ˚रणि, ‘to take revenge’), MBh.
a: प्रतियत् — {c1c} A. To try. --Caus. 1 To restore, return. --2 To retaliate, requite.

m: प्रति-˚यत्न m. care bestowed upon anything, effort, endeavour, exertion, Pāṇ. i, 3, 32
preparation, elaboration, manufacture, Śiś. iii, 54 (cf. अ-प्र्˚-पूर्व)
imparting a new quality or virtue, Kāś. on Pāṇ. ii, 3, 53
retaliation, requital, W.
(also = लिप्सा, उपग्रह or ˚हण, निग्रहादि, ग्रहणादि, प्रतिग्रह, L.)
प्रति-˚यत्न mfn. exerting one's self, taking care or trouble, L.
cautious, heedful, Jātakam.
a: प्रतियत्न — a. 1 Troubling about. --2 Active, vigorous. --त्नः 1 An effort, endeavour, exertion. --2 Preparation, elaboration; Śi. 3. 54. --3 Making complete or perfect. --4 Imparting a new quality or virtue; सतो गुणांतराधानं प्रतियत्नः Kāśi. on P. II. 3. 53. --5 Wish, desire. --6 Opposition, resistance. --7 Retaliation, retribution, revenge. --8 Making captive, taking prisoner. --9 Favour. --10 Acting well or properly. --11 Comprehension.

a: प्रतियोधः, प्रतियोधिन्, प्रतियोद्धृ — m. An adversary, opponent.

प्रति-˚योद्धव्य mfn. to be attacked in return, MBh.

one who begins a battle, Mn. xi, 81 (v.l.)

an antidote, remedy, Kathās.
cooperation, association, W.
the being a counterpart of anything, ib.
a: प्रतियोगः — 1 Being or forming a counter-part, of anything. --2 Opposition, resistance. --3 Contradiction. --4 Co-operation. --5 An antidote, a remedy.

प्रति-˚योगि in comp. = ˚योगिन्
प्रति-˚योगि—ज्ञान-कारणता f. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—ज्ञान-कारणता-वाद m. N. of wk.

प्रति-˚योगिक—त्व n.

m: प्रति-˚योगिन् mfn. id., Tarkas.; Śaṃk.; TS., Sch. &c. (cf. अ-प्रतिय्˚)
प्रति-˚योगिन् m. an adversary, rival, Mcar.
any object dependent upon another and not existing without it, W.
a partner, associate, ib.
a counterpart, match, ib.
a: प्रतियोगिन् — a. 1 Opposing, counteracting, impeding. --2 Related or corresponding to, being or forming a counter-part of (anything); often used in works on Nyāya; as a घट is the प्रतियोगी of घटाभाव; (यस्याभावो बिवक्ष्यते स प्रतियोगी). --3 Co-operating with. --4 Equally matched. --m. 1 An adversary, opponent, enemy; दहत्यशेषं प्रतियोगिगर्वं Vikr. 1. 117. --2 A counter-part, match. --3 A partner, an associate. --4 An object dependent upon another. --5 A counter-part, counter-entity; प्रतियोगिनानाधीनज्ञानविषयत्वमभावलक्षणम्.

m: प्रति-˚योगि—निरूपण n. N. of wk.
प्रति-˚योगि—ता f. correlation, dependent existence, Bhāṣāp., Sch.
mutual co-operation, partnership, W.
a: प्रतियोगिता त्वं — 1 Opposition. --2 Dependent existence --3 Being a counter-part. --4 Partnership, cooperation.

m: प्रति-˚योगि—ता-वाद m. N. of wk.

प्रति-√ युध् Ā. P. -युध्यते, ˚ति, to fight against, be a match for (acc.), fight, MBh.; Hariv.; R. : Caus. -योधयति id., MBh.; Var.
a: प्रतियुध् — {c4c} A. To encounter in fight, oppose.

m: प्रति-˚युद्ध mfn. fought against, fought, R.
प्रति-˚युद्ध n. fighting against, battle in return, Hariv.
प्रति-√ युज् P. Ā. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, to fasten on, tie to (acc.), RV.; (Ā.) to pay back (a debt), MBh. (C. प्रति-प्रय्˚) : Caus. -योजयति, to fix on, adjust (the arrow on the bow), MBh.
प्रति-˚युत mfn. tied to, bound, fettered, ib.

प्रति-˚युवन n. repeated mixture, Hcat.
प्रति—युवति f. a concubine, female rival, Vcar.
